current_assessment: A thermal runaway event in the PCU thermal zone is in progress. Temperature has spiked to 71.2°C in the PCU, with heat spreading to the instrument bay (29.1°C) and bus (38.6°C). FDIR has activated emergency cooling and reduced computational load. Temperature is stabilising but remains well above nominal. All electronics are at elevated risk.

early_warning_signs: PCU temp sustained above 68°C for >5 min

Monitor PCU temperature every 30 seconds — autonomous safe mode trigger at 68°C

earth_report:
EMERGENCY REPORT — ASTERIA-7 T+09:42

FDIR EVENT: PCU thermal runaway detected. Temperature 71.2°C — 30°C above nominal.

CURRENT STATUS: CRITICAL — thermal runaway in PCU zone with heat spreading to instrument bay. FDIR cooling response active. Temperature stabilising but not yet safe.

PRIMARY RISK: PCU component thermal failure possible within 45 minutes if temperature does not decrease. Complete power loss would result.

ACTIONS TAKEN BY FDIR: Emergency thermal control activated, radiators deployed, computational load reduced 30%, instrument heaters disabled.

GROUND RECOMMENDATIONS: (1) AUTHORISE EMERGENCY POWER REDUCTION TO 280W IMMEDIATELY. (2) Approve deep-space pointing attitude. (3) Prepare safe mode command sequence for autonomous uplink. (4) All available mission controllers to stations.

MISSION IMPACT: CRITICAL. Immediate ground action required. Mission at risk.
